title.zh: 把共同安排与各自愿意承担的部分分开
title.en: Separate shared arrangements from willing contributions

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上面的种子交换桌，先区分需要一起商量的时间与信息，以及每个人愿意承担的部分。可以询问一次，不替沉默的人认领任务；自己也可以说不承担协调。复盘看哪些条件已达成共识、哪些仍未确认，不以安排得多、别人听从或活动顺利证明国王身份。若另一人想先做小样或欣赏种子故事，可以保留不同起点，而不是把协调排在其他角色之上。
paragraphs.en: For the seed-exchange table above, distinguish timing and information needing agreement from the part each person wants to contribute. Ask without assigning work to someone who stays silent; you may decline coordination too. Review agreed and unconfirmed conditions without proving a King identity through the amount arranged, obedience or a smooth event. Someone may prefer a sample or seed story first; retain different starting points without ranking coordination above the other roles.

title.zh: 用普通情境交流角色隐喻
title.en: Discuss role metaphors through an ordinary situation

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果准备一张种子交换桌，哪些事需要共同决定，哪些任务要先问各自愿不愿意？”交换愿意先看什么，不比较谁更像男人、更成熟、更有能力，也不按角色给别人分配任务或关系义务。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “For a seed-exchange table, what would need a shared decision and which tasks would require checking who wants to contribute?” Compare what you would attend to first without ranking masculinity, maturity or ability, or assigning tasks or relationship duties through roles.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。任何人都可以换一个起点、不回答或结束；无需披露性别、私人经历或证明符合某种角色，也不用再做测试。
paragraphs.en: You can share this public guide; its link contains no answers or counts. Anyone may choose another start, decline or stop without disclosing gender or private experiences, proving a role or taking another test.

title.zh: 让一箱物品的承诺有清楚终点
title.en: Give a one-box commitment a clear endpoint

paragraphs.zh: 回到上面的活动用品重新装箱，先说愿意处理哪一箱、完成到什么状态，以及哪些情况需要再商量。做完可以说明仍未处理的部分；条件变化也可以调整，不必把全部物品接过来。复盘关注约定与实际范围，不用忍耐、连续工作或拒绝帮助来证明战士。没有合适条件时可以暂停或不参与，这些选择不能由计数被叫作软弱。
paragraphs.en: For repacking the activity supplies above, name the box you would handle, its intended finished state and conditions requiring another discussion. Report what remains undone or revise the agreement if circumstances change without taking every box. Review the agreement and actual scope without proving Warrior through endurance, uninterrupted work or refusing help. Pause or decline when conditions do not fit; a count cannot classify these choices as weakness.

title.zh: 用普通情境交流角色隐喻
title.en: Discuss role metaphors through an ordinary situation

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果只愿意重新装一箱用品，怎样说明完成范围、交接状态和需要重新商量的条件？”交换愿意先看什么，不比较谁更像男人、更成熟、更有能力，也不按角色给别人分配任务或关系义务。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If you wanted to repack one box, how would you specify its scope, handover state and conditions needing renegotiation?” Compare what you would attend to first without ranking masculinity, maturity or ability, or assigning tasks or relationship duties through roles.

title.zh: 让一轮模拟只回答一个具体问题
title.en: Let one simulation address one specific question

paragraphs.zh: 沿用上面的工具借还提示，挑一个普通例子，区分已知步骤、自己猜测的理解，以及一轮纸面模拟可能澄清的地方。模拟后仍不清楚，也可以保留未知或改问愿意参与的人。不要把小样的结果扩大到所有使用者。复盘关注哪条信息来自实际检查，不用找到巧妙答案、比别人更快或计数更高证明智慧，也不据此解释他人的潜意识和动机。
paragraphs.en: For the tool-loan notice above, choose one ordinary example and separate known steps, your guesses about understanding and what a paper simulation might clarify. Keep uncertainty or ask a willing person if the simulation leaves questions. Do not generalise the example to every user. Review which information came from checking without proving wisdom through cleverness, speed or a higher count, or interpreting another person’s unconscious processes or motives.

title.zh: 用普通情境交流角色隐喻
title.en: Discuss role metaphors through an ordinary situation

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果模拟一次工具借还，哪个步骤已经知道，哪个理解只是猜测，小样又能核对哪一部分？”交换愿意先看什么，不比较谁更像男人、更成熟、更有能力，也不按角色给别人分配任务或关系义务。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “In a simulated tool loan and return, which step would be known, which understanding a guess and what could the example check?” Compare what you would attend to first without ranking masculinity, maturity or ability, or assigning tasks or relationship duties through roles.

paragraphs.zh: 可以只分享这份公开说明，链接不含答案或计数。任何人都可以换一个起点、不回答或结束；无需披露性别、私人经历或证明符合某种角色，也不用再做测试。

title.zh: 回应一个愿意分享的细节
title.en: Respond to a willingly shared detail

paragraphs.zh: 回到上面的旧明信片，选一个对方自己提起的细节，可以问是否希望单独保留，也可以安静欣赏字迹或颜色。对方不想解释时，不补出隐藏故事；自己也不必继续交流。复盘关注哪些内容是自愿分享、哪些仍未知，不以亲近程度、情绪表达多少或别人是否感动证明情人角色。保留私密感受与专注任务同样可以，不由低计数判冷漠。
paragraphs.en: For the old postcards above, respond to a detail the person volunteered, perhaps asking whether to keep a card separately, or quietly appreciate handwriting or colour. Supply no hidden story if they decline to explain, and retain your own choice to end the exchange. Review what was willingly shared and what remains unknown without proving Lover through closeness, emotional disclosure or moving someone. Privacy and task focus remain possible; a lower count establishes no coldness.

title.zh: 用普通情境交流角色隐喻
title.en: Discuss role metaphors through an ordinary situation

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果朋友说某张明信片值得保留，怎样回应这个细节，同时不给对方增加解释私人经历的压力？”交换愿意先看什么，不比较谁更像男人、更成熟、更有能力，也不按角色给别人分配任务或关系义务。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a friend wanted a postcard retained, how could you respond without adding pressure to explain a private experience?” Compare what you would attend to first without ranking masculinity, maturity or ability, or assigning tasks or relationship duties through roles.
